verdict.rationale: The portal's own pages offer online registration and login ('Registar-se ... Iniciar Sessão') and an entry point to tax services ('Aceda aos Serviços Tributários'). They also show an online transaction: subscribing to electronic notifications, either for yourself or on someone else's behalf. However, none of the cited text explicitly says a founder can file a tax return or pay taxes online, so the core transaction is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit first-party evidence of online filing of declarations, online tax payment, an online business/activity registration flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages
